players.product: SSD testers for enterprise / data-center SSDs (CPU-based PCIe Gen5 and Gen6 NVMe, SAS, SATA) and SSD automation test systems

quarterly_data.signal: Two correction filings (2026-08-28) move the end dates of supply contracts with its US subsidiary NEOSEM TECHNOLOGY INC. (overseas supply) from 2026-08-31 to 2026-12-31 after the delivery schedule was changed in consultation with the customer: (1) Gen6 SSD tester and module contract from 2026-05-06, USD 5,803,524.00 (KRW 8,534,082,042, 13.35% of 2025 consolidated revenue), payment within 60 days of delivery; (2) semiconductor test equipment contract from 2026-02-10 (voluntary disclosure), USD 4,558,332 (KRW 6,674,765,547, 6.34% of 2024 consolidated revenue), payment within 90 days of delivery.
